summary: Westbay’s first-property setup should use individual, role-based access; company-wide payment allocation with rent paid last; a separate Rental Assistance ledger; conventional 12-month leasing; staff-controlled electronic leases and renewals; agent-led tours; advance charge visibility beginning on the 25th; Homebody resident access; automated $20 late fees beginning on the second; formal delinquency handling above $100; and rentable $10 carports. Later calls supersede earlier positions on privacy policy and late fees: Westbay entered its privacy policy as open text, and replaced the earlier discount concept by reducing migrated rents $20 and charging an actual $20 late fee. Deposit Alternative remains out of scope.

Key topics included resident portal enrollment, the integration of "HomeBuddy," and the configuration of maintenance locations, problems, and inspection workflows, with a focus on tailoring these to Westbay Management's specific operational needs and timelines. The call concluded with planning for upcoming training and a follow-up meeting to address post-migration tasks and further implementation.

callsUsed.title: Westbay Management + Entrata: Weekly Sync
callsUsed.brief: Matthew, JR, Hannah and Sultan from Entrata, along with Kim Komaromi, Kim Komaromi and Cheryl from Westbay Management, discussed the migration of trial balances, particularly the challenges with Legacy Five's combined balance sheet, and the need for separate financials for each property. They also covered outstanding items like the PMQ, floor plan mapping, and bank account verification, with Sultan confirming his departure and the introduction of a new Project Manager, Ella, to ensure a smooth transition and continued progress on post-migration implementations.

callsUsed.title: Entrata / Westbay - Operations Consultation cont'd / go-live help
callsUsed.brief: Matthew from Entrata, along with Kim and Cheryl from Westbay Management, discussed the rollout of the Homebody resident portal, emphasizing the need to collect resident email addresses for activation and outlining a plan for their acquisition. They also finalized the company's late notice and collections policies, including the implementation of a "Demand for possession, non payment of rent" notice for balances over $100 and a streamlined collections process with a 15-day notice period. The team acknowledged ongoing property migration issues and planned to address further setup details once all properties are live.

callsUsed.title: Westbay Management + Entrata Pre migration Accounting Consultation
callsUsed.brief: Lydia from Entrata discussed check formatting, bank reconciliation procedures, and migration discrepancies with the team. She advised on using the "copy stub check" format, automating positive pay transmissions, and managing outstanding items during reconciliations. The parties agreed to establish recurring weekly meetings to continue addressing accounting workflows, with specific adjustments made to the schedule for upcoming absences.

callsUsed.title: Westbay / Entrata - Rent Reporting / Lease setup
callsUsed.brief: Matthew from Entrata, along with Kim from Westbay Management, discussed configuring lease renewal workflows, finalizing HomeBuddy rent reporting integration, and organizing lease packet templates. They decided to implement a monthly marketing cadence for HomeBuddy, established a new charge code for reporting services, and agreed on a specific order for lease documents, including dynamic inclusion rules for pet and carport addendums.
